method: Playwright Chromium, 1440x1000 viewport, real File Cabinet with mocked read responses. Baseline viewer count comes from research/large-lists-results.json after table windowing; the intervening Git diff change does not alter File Cabinet. Candidate metrics are attached by tests/large-lists.spec.ts.
context: DOM/layout counts, not foreground timing, frame-rate or heap measurements
limits: Full folder data and flattened expanded hierarchy remain in memory.
Browser-native Find sees mounted text; application folder filtering sees the full data.
Native forms, DOM focus, expansion and navigation remain in use; no canvas changes.
Foreground Electron/browser traces, heap profiling and the mixed 50-app soak remain pending.
